senses.gloss:
इल r. 6th cl. (इलति)
 1. To sleep.
 2. To go.
 3. To throw, send or direct:
in this last sense, it is also r. 10th cl. (एलयति.)

इला f. (-ला)
 1. The wife of BUDDHA, and daughter of IKSHWAKU.
 2.
The earth.
 3. A cow.
 4. Speech.
 E. इल् to send, क and टाप् affixes;
also इडा.
इलविला f. (-ला) The mother of KUVERA.

इलागोल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe.
 E. इला and गोल a sphere.

इलातल n. (-लं)
 1. The fourth place in the circle of the zodiac.
 2. The
surface of the earth.
 E. इला and तल below.

इलावृत n. (-तं) One of the nine Varṣas or divisions of the known world,
comprehending the highest and most centrical part of the old
continent.
 E. इला the earth, and आवृत chosen: the fairest part of the
globe.

इल्लल m. (-लः) A bird.
 E. इल् to go, and अल who is able.
